entities.summary: St Martin's is the northernmost populated island of the Isles of Scilly, Cornwall, England, United Kingdom. It has an area of 237 hectares (0.92 sq mi) and a total population of 135. Four regions of the island are designated as Sites of Special Scientific Interest.
